title: The problem
body: Every supplier wants it\ntheir own way.
vo: Sending purchase orders to suppliers should be simple. But every supplier wants it their own way. A different file format, a different delivery channel, their own item codes. So procurement teams end up reformatting every order by hand.

title: Upload an order
body: PDF · CSV · XLSX · cXML\nUBL · EDIFACT · X12 · IDoc
vo: ProcuLink replaces that. You drop in your order, in whatever format it already lives in. A PDF, a spreadsheet, a CSV, cXML, UBL, EDIFACT, X12. ProcuLink detects the format automatically and reads every line.

title: Review and resolve
body: Only the lines that\nneed your attention.
vo: Then it surfaces only the lines that actually need a decision. Not the whole order. You see your code, the supplier's code, and exactly what's unresolved, side by side, in one place.

title: AI item-code mapping
vo: When a supplier uses different item codes, the AI suggests the mapping, with a confidence score and the reason behind it. You stay in control. And every correction you make, it remembers for next time.

title: Validate
vo: Before anything leaves your hands, the order is checked against that supplier's own acceptance rules. So it isn't rejected at the other end, after you thought it was sent.

title: Transform and deliver
body: Their exact format.\nHTTP · SFTP · Email · ERP.
vo: Then ProcuLink transforms the order into the exact format that supplier requires, and delivers it. Over HTTP, SFTP, or email, or straight into their ERP, like Erply or Directo.

title: Proof of delivery
body: Every step logged.\nProof for every order.
vo: And every step is logged. A complete audit trail, and proof of delivery, for every single order. Boringly reliable, by design.

title: Start free
body: Try it with a\nsample order today.
vo: That's ProcuLink. The missing link between buyers and suppliers. Try it free with a sample order today, at proculink dot e u.
